data.one_liner: Smooth, sliver-based drag and resize grid engine for Flutter dashboards.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sliver-native layout engine for building interactive dashboards with drag-and-drop, resizing, nested grids, and viewport virtualization. It composes natively with Flutter's scrolling system and supports responsive layouts across platforms.
use_when: Building user-configurable dashboards, analytics platforms, or IoT control panels
You need complex grid layouts with drag-and-drop and resizing inside a CustomScrollView
Managing nested grids with cross-sliver drag-and-drop support
avoid_when: Building standard static UI forms or simple lists that do not require grid repositioning
You need a simple non-scrollable table or layout
strengths: High performance virtualization and fast collision resolution
Rich set of features including nested grids, cross-sliver drag-and-drop, and minimap support
Fully customizable interaction policies, compaction, and responsive breakpoints
weaknesses: Large API surface with many configuration options which can take time to master
Custom implementation required if integrating external state management beyond the provided controller
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and instantiate a DashboardController.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose responsive_framework for adaptive scaling and responsive breakpoints across generic app screens instead of a widget-level dashboard drag-and-drop grid.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose responsive_builder for building different UI layouts based on screen size using simple builders rather than an interactive sliver dashboard engine.
